faq.title: Frequently asked questions about AI interview preparation

items.q: How do I prepare for a job interview with AI?
items.a: Start with your resume and the targeted job offer. BeyondTheCV helps you analyze the role's expectations, prepare your pitch, and practice interview questions. Feedback on your answers lets you target the areas to improve before meeting the recruiter.
An application corresponds to the pairing of a company and a targeted role. You get 5 new applications every month.

items.q: Can I prepare for several roles at the same company?
items.a: Yes. Each role is a separate application, but the company analysis you've already done can be reused instead of being rebuilt unnecessarily.

items.q: What is an analyzed practice session?
items.a: It's an answer, a pitch, a role-play, or a short simulation that BeyondTheCV analyzes to give you feedback and help you progress.

items.q: What happens to unused practice sessions?
items.a: They can be carried over from one month to the next, up to a limit of 200 available sessions. Beyond that cap, new monthly sessions are no longer added.

items.q: What is the evolving strategic profile for?
items.a: It summarizes what's been observed during your preparation, highlighting your strengths, areas for improvement, and your three current priorities. It evolves with your new exercises and interviews.

items.q: Is the strategic profile a psychological assessment?
items.a: No. It's based on the information you've provided and on the performance observed within the app. The scores are preparation indicators, not a prediction of a recruiter's behavior or a psychological diagnosis.
No. It's monthly and can be cancelled at any time.

items.q: Why pay when ChatGPT or Claude already exist?
items.a: BeyondTheCV isn't limited to generating text. It durably connects your profile, your applications, your practice sessions, your progress, and your debriefs within a specialized method.

items.q: Does BeyondTheCV guarantee a job offer?
items.a: No. No serious tool can guarantee a hiring decision. BeyondTheCV helps you arrive better prepared and improve from one interview to the next.

final.title: Your next application deserves better than improvised preparation.
final.text: Centralize your applications, practice your answers, and let your strategic profile show you what to work on next.

contingency_plan_feedback: Does this contingency plan cover the unexpected situations you fear?
contingency_plan_desc: Ready-to-use responses to stay professional even when the interview doesn't go as planned.

contingency_plans.title: Video connection issue
contingency_plans.content:
Hello,

I am having a connection issue joining our interview. I am trying to reconnect immediately.

If the problem persists, I remain reachable by phone at [Your Number] and am available to continue the exchange in whatever format suits you.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
[First Name Last Name]

contingency_plans.title: Recruiter is late (> 5 min)
contingency_plans.content:
Hello,

I am connected for our interview scheduled at [time]. I remain available online.

Please let me know if you would like to keep the exchange or reschedule it for a more convenient time.

Best regards,
[First Name Last Name]

contingency_plans.title: You are late
contingency_plans.content:
Hello,

I am sorry, something unexpected came up and I will be a few minutes late for our interview.

I am doing my best to be available as soon as possible. If this disrupts your schedule, I will of course adapt to your availability.

Best regards,
[First Name Last Name]

contingency_plans.title: Noise or unexpected interruption
contingency_plans.content: Please excuse this interruption. Just give me a moment to sort this out... Alright, I am back with you.

contingency_plans.title: Memory blank
contingency_plans.content: That is an excellent question. I will take a few seconds to structure my answer so I can respond clearly.

contingency_plans.title: Aggressive / destabilizing question
contingency_plans.content: That is a fair point. I will not dodge it: there is indeed something to explain. What I mainly take away from it is [lesson], and that is precisely what enables me today to approach this type of situation more methodically.

contingency_plans.title: Salary brought up too early
contingency_plans.content: I would first like to make sure I fully understand the exact scope of the role, the expected responsibilities, and your top priorities. This will allow me to give you a consistent and realistic range.

contingency_plans.title: Recruiter is cold or unexpressive
contingency_plans.content: (Posture to adopt) Stay factual and do not over-interpret. Focus on your structure (STAR), ask open questions to involve them (What is the main challenge in this role right now?) and check their understanding (Does that answer your question?).

contingency_plans.title: Interview ends without clear next steps
contingency_plans.content: Thank you for this very informative exchange. I am very interested. What are the next steps in the process on your side?
